tools_used: pypdf (local text extraction of fetched PDFs)
helpful: The provisioned petition, QP, and BIO text were clean and complete.
The frozen band and the sal-v4 segment table made the anchor unambiguous.
Forward-mode web access to the docket page exposed the un-provisioned State brief, which carried the decisive signal.
gaps: The document pipeline fetched only one of two respondent briefs; on a multi-respondent docket the 'Brief of respondent <State>' entry should be provisioned alongside the 'in opposition' brief, and the reply brief too.
No PDF text extractor is installed in the cell; the fetch tool's model-written PDF summaries were wrong for two of three briefs, so I had to pull pypdf ad hoc.
No corpus cut for 'respondent requests GVR' or 'response requested after waiver', which were the two signals that mattered most here.
notes: Retrieval: 17 calls (4 web searches, 10 web fetches, 2 corpus queries, 1 MCP search), under the advisory budget of 25.
